title: Secret-chat inline-bot alert stash is per window, not per chat: a SwitchInline query pressed in one secret chat is inserted into another
trigger: In secret chat A press a bot's SwitchInline button (first inline use this session): the privacy banner shows and the query is stashed. Without confirming, open secret chat B in the same window. The banner is still shown in B; press its confirm.
effect: A's bot query text is inserted into B's composer and the inline query runs in B. The only guard (open_chat_is_secret) passes for any secret chat; nothing on chat change clears ComposerUi::pending_inline_bot_alert (writers: inline_mode.rs:111/123, close_chat_preview.rs:860/866/885).
fix: Move the stash into ChatUi (replaced on chat change) or store it as Option<(ChatId, String)> and drop it when the chat differs.

title: vCard read token restarts at 0 per box, so a read from a closed Import box lands in the reopened one
trigger: Contacts > Import, choose a large .vcf A (box shows Reading). Close the box, reopen Import and choose a small file B. B finishes first and shows; A finishes later.
effect: A's read has pick 1, the same as B's in the new box (ImportContactsDialog::default() resets pick to 0), so the box switches to A's contacts and Import sends A's contacts. The doc comment says a read after closing is dropped, which is not true.
fix: Take the pick token from an app-lifetime counter (or a per-box id), so a token never repeats across box instances.

title: Add Contact box closes when addContact is sent; a TDLib error is silently dropped
trigger: Open a user's profile > Add Contact, enter a phone number TDLib refuses (or hit a server error), press Add Contact.
effect: The box closes with 'Contact add requested' and nothing else. apply_users_error has no arm for RequestPurpose::AddContact (only AddContactByPhone), so the user never learns that the add failed.
fix: Keep the box open in a Saving stage until the answer (match by request id), then close on ok or show the error in the box.

title: Sync contacts switch stays flipped when saving contacts_prefs.json fails
trigger: Settings > Contacts > toggle Sync contacts while the data folder is not writable.
effect: An error toast shows, but the in-memory pref (and the switch) stays at the new value. After a restart it is back to the old value.
fix: Save first and apply the new value only on success, or roll the in-memory value back on error.

title: Contacts list fetch is contacts: Option plus contacts_error: bool plus an in-flight GetContacts request
trigger: n/a
effect: The tab derives loading, failed or ready from three sources kept in step by hand (connect/contacts.rs:29/48, users/error.rs:150, users/apply.rs, session_apply_ok.rs).
fix: One Fetch<Vec<ContactRow>> (src/state/fetch.rs) for the contacts list.

title: MenuFocus keeps menu open/closed as was_open: bool beside previous: Option<FocusHandle>
trigger: n/a
effect: menu_focus_upkeep sets and clears both by hand on each edge. 'previous is Some only while was_open' is not enforced.
fix: enum MenuFocusStage { Closed, Open { previous: Option<FocusHandle> } }.

title: A key in a chat window's message menu closes the main window's chat-row submenu
trigger: In the main window right-click a chat row and hover a row with a submenu, so it opens. Without closing it, right-click a message in a chat window and press an arrow key.
effect: open_submenu() reads the screen-wide chat_list.menu / community row_menu. parent_of finds no parent in the chat window's items, so the main window's submenu is closed as stale.
fix: Read open_submenu only when !windows.in_window(), the same gate as main_menu_open.

title: Schedule popup is schedule_popup_open: bool beside schedule_picker: Option<SchedulePicker>
trigger: n/a
effect: Five writers clear the bool (toggle_composer_silent.rs:107/393, composer/mod.rs:567, send_prep.rs:450, scheduled.rs:362) and leave the picker Some. Only scheduled.rs:298 clears both.
fix: One Option<SchedulePicker> whose Some is 'open' (the picker carries its target).

title: Connection stage is connection.status plus auth_demo.demo_state plus the note, set together by hand
trigger: n/a
effect: start_connection, the close-unconfirmed arm and open_client each write ConnectUiStatus and AuthorizationState (StartupFailed, WaitPhoneNumber) as a pair, plus clear_note or set_note.
fix: One enum ScreenConnect { Connecting, Live, Blocked(StartupFailure), NeedCredentials(String) }, with the status and the card derived from it.

title: Deferred chrome redraw is chrome_notify_pending: Cell<bool> beside the chrome_due list
trigger: n/a
effect: The flag is set before a cx.defer and cleared only in finish_chrome_notify (with a slot fallback). A dropped defer leaves it set, which stops later notifies for that history.
fix: enum ChromeNotify { Idle, Scheduled } owned by the history, or one Option<Vec<usize>> whose Some is 'scheduled'.

title: History window anchoring is key + window_epoch + anchor_pending: bool + last_highlight, kept in step by hand
trigger: n/a
effect: anchor_pending (baseline debt) is set on a new window and cleared in rows_replaced, and is read by reselect_open_chat and remember_scroll.
fix: enum WindowAnchor { Anchoring { key, epoch }, Anchored { key, epoch } }.

title: Country box shows 'Loading countries...' forever when getCountries fails or is never sent
trigger: Go offline (or have TDLib answer getCountries with an error or an empty list), open a checkout with a shipping address and click the Country field, or open a poll's Allowed Countries box.
effect: The list says 'Loading countries...' with no error and no retry for as long as the box is open; only closing and reopening asks again. open_country_box ignores fetch_countries' Err (`let _ =`), and the reducer keeps auth_state.countries None on an error or an empty answer, so 'not asked', 'loading' and 'failed' all read as None.
fix: Hold the list as Fetch<Vec<Country>> (src/state/fetch.rs): the error arm and a send failure set Failed, and the box draws an error row with Retry for Failed and the loading text only for Loading.

title: Custom emoji card is three fields in step: per-window tapped/seen plus one session-wide preview
trigger: Tap a custom emoji in a chat window, then within 6 s tap the same emoji in the main window (or click the card's Close in one window).
effect: Stickers::custom_emoji_preview is one session slot, but MessageUi::custom_emoji_tapped and custom_emoji_card_seen are per window. The first window's 6-second timer (or its Close) clears the session preview, so the other window's card disappears early. A tap whose preview request fails leaves custom_emoji_tapped set with no card. The card also stays up to 6 s after the reader switches to another chat (MessageUi is per window, not per ChatUi).
fix: One per-window enum EmojiCard { Asked { emoji_id }, Shown { preview, timer } } in ChatUi. The answer goes to the window whose request carried it (WindowViews), not to a session-wide slot, so a timer or Close clears only its own card.

title: A dismissed one-time bot keyboard is remembered per window, not per chat
trigger: Open a bot chat with a one-time reply keyboard in a chat window, press a button (the keyboard hides there), and look at the same chat in another window while offline or before TDLib's updateChatReplyMarkup lands.
effect: MessageUi lives in the WindowSlot, so dismissed_keyboards and collapsed_keyboards keyed (chat, message) apply only in the window that pressed. The other window keeps showing the one-time keyboard until TDLib clears the markup, and an offline dismissal never reaches it.
fix: Keep the dismissed set per chat with its owner, keyed AccountChat, in the session's per-chat reply-markup state, which every window reads. Keep collapsed (a per-view choice) per window if that is intended.

title: A pending media-timestamp seek outlives the chat it was for and plays or opens media after the reader left
trigger: Click a t.me/c/<chat>/<post>?t=90 link to a voice note or video that is not loaded yet, then open another chat at once. Within 12 s the linked message loads (the history answer that was in flight).
effect: tick_media_seek still runs seek_media_timestamp for the old chat. It starts the voice note or audio playing, or opens the media viewer on the video, over the chat the reader moved to. PlaybackUi::pending_media_seek is cleared only when the seek runs or its deadline passes, never on a chat change.
fix: Make the pending seek part of the chat's ChatUi (replaced whole by sync_chat_ui), or carry the ChatMessage owner and the window and drop the seek when that chat is no longer shown there.

title: A resolved link waiting for its frame is three fields: pending_deep_link_open, pending_deep_link_ui and one shared pending_flow_window
trigger: A chat open from the share chooser (choose_share_chat -> hold_resolved_link) while a typed-link UI step from another window is still waiting for its frame.
effect: Today the two kinds rarely overlap. When they do, the second hold_resolved_link overwrites pending_flow_window, and the first link's box or chat runs in the second link's window. The 'which frame runs it' answer comes from three Options read together in resolved_link_frame.
fix: One Option<ResolvedLink { window: Option<ChatId>, step: ResolvedStep::{Open(PendingOpen), Ui(DeepLinkUi)} }>, so each waiting step carries its own window and a new one replaces the old whole.

title: An invite Join that fails to send shows its error box in the main window, not in the chat window of the invite box
trigger: Click a t.me/+hash invite link in a chat window, lose the connection, and press Join in the invite box.
effect: confirm_deep_link_invite's error arm sets DeepLinkState::ShowText('Couldn't reach Telegram.'), but Links::flow_window is set only on Ok(Some(_)). The next pump opens the DeepLinkInfo box with from_window None, so it appears in the main window, possibly hidden or behind. When the chats path is inactive (Err(InvalidRequest)), the session keeps InvitePreview while the UI copy was taken, so the invite box reopens with no message. Links::deep_link_invite is a hand-kept copy of ChatsState::deep_link.
fix: Set flow_window from the asking window before calling confirm, whatever it returns, and drop the UI copy: draw the invite box from ChatsState::deep_link, matched by generation.

title: Any pending outgoing message newer than the view counts as 'the reader just sent it' and scrolls the history to the end
trigger: Scroll up in a chat in the main window. Forward a message into that chat from a chat window, or have the agent send one into it.
effect: sent_since takes any is_outgoing && pending() message after the newest one as the reader's own send in this view. The main window jumps to the bottom and loses the reader's place, although the send came from another window or the agent.
fix: Mark sends made from this view (the composer's send records its local id in the window's ChatUi) and test that mark, not just pending outgoing state.

title: Closing a chat window that hosts the account notice box dismisses up to 8 queued notices unseen, including a force-logout one
trigger: Click anything in a chat window; two or more service notices arrive (updateServiceNotification), the first a force-logout (AUTH_KEY_DROP_*) notice; the AccountNotice box shows in that chat window; close the chat window with its title-bar close or Cmd-W.
effect: close_window_boxes runs the box's close (dismiss_account_notice) while account_notice() is Some, up to 8 times: every queued service notice, the login-prevented box and the frozen/age boxes are popped without being shown, and the force-logout notice (whose own box cannot be dismissed) goes away without the log out it demands.
fix: Give AccountNotice a close that closes the box view, not the notices (a front-notice cursor that is only advanced by its own buttons), or register it without a close so it is freed to the window of the last press like the call swap prompt; never dismiss a force-logout notice from a close.

title: Force-logout service notice is dismissed before request_logout, so a refused or failed log out loses the notice silently
trigger: A force-logout service notice shows; press Log out while the auth state is not Ready or the TDLib send fails (connection closing).
effect: The notice is popped and `let _ = request_logout()` drops the error: the box disappears, the account stays signed in and nothing tells the user.
fix: Pop the notice only when request_logout returns Ok (or when the logout answer lands); on Err keep it and show the error in the box.

title: review_pending sticks above zero when one of several confirm/terminate sends fails, disabling the new-login banner for good
trigger: Two or more unconfirmed logins are listed in the 'Someone just got access' banner (account_notices.rs unconfirmed_login_banner); press 'Yes, it's me' or 'No, it's not me!' while the TDLib sender fails on the first or a middle send.
effect: review_pending is set to ids.len() up front; a failed send calls finish_login_review once and returns, so the requests never sent are never counted down. The banner's busy = review_pending > 0 stays true: both buttons stay disabled until restart, and review_outcome never comes.
fix: One enum `LoginReview { Idle, Running { confirmed, left: BTreeSet<RequestId>, error }, Done(LoginReviewOutcome) }`; on a failed send drop every id not yet sent from `left` before finishing.

title: Terms box step and age checkbox are never reset, so a later terms prompt opens pre-ticked or on the Decline step
trigger: Tick 'I confirm that I am N or older' and Agree (or go to Decline > Back is not pressed, e.g. Decline then the terms are cleared); later in the same run TDLib sends a new updateTermsOfService.
effect: AuthUi::terms_age_ok stays true and terms_step keeps its old value (only AuthUi::new sets them): the new terms show the age box already ticked, or open on the 'sorry'/delete warning step.
fix: Keep the box's step and age answer in one `TermsBox { terms_id, step, age_ok }` value created when a terms id first shows, so a new id starts a fresh value.

title: Terms accept round-trip is terms_in_flight bool beside terms_error
trigger: n/a
effect: Agree/Decline enablement and the error line read two fields kept in step by accept_terms, the ok answer and the error answer.
fix: `terms_accept: Fetch<()>`-style enum (Idle, Sending(RequestId), Failed(String)) carried with the terms id.

title: New community box closes and toasts 'Community created' as soon as the request is sent; a refusal arrives after the box is gone
trigger: Side menu > Communities > Create community; enter a name, pick a chat, press Create; TDLib refuses createCommunity (e.g. not enough rights, chat type not allowed).
effect: submit_create_community_dialog took the dialog and showed 'Community created' on send; the CreateFailed outcome then toasts a failure. The user saw success first and lost the typed name and selection. (State comment says 'the box stays' as tdesktop does.) Also Ok(None) for a create already in flight shows 'Could not create community'.
fix: Keep the box open in a `CreateCommunityDialog { stage: Editing | Sending(RequestId) }` stage; close it and toast success only on the matched ok answer, return to Editing with the error on the matched failure.

title: Device-link result that lands after leaving the Devices page shows as a stale notice on the next visit
trigger: Settings > Devices > Link device (scan or paste a tg://login link) > Link device; leave the Devices page before Telegram answers; open Devices again later.
effect: poll_device_qr clears the UI and returns while the page is not Devices without taking session.settings.device_login_result; the next visit shows 'Device linked' / 'couldn't be linked' for the old attempt.
fix: Drop or consume device_login_result when the flow is cleared (clear_device_qr), or key it by the ConfirmDeviceLogin request id held in the UI's link stage.

title: Device linking stage is three Options: scanner, scanned link, notice
trigger: n/a (side effect: paste a link while the camera scan runs; the scanner's later result overwrites the pasted link)
effect: device_qr_scanner, device_login_qr and device_link_notice can all be set at once; scan_device_qr checks two, paste_device_login_link checks one.
fix: `enum DeviceLink { Idle(Option<notice>), Scanning(DeviceQrScanner), Confirm(Zeroizing<String>), Linking(RequestId) }`.

title: Edit Folder box shows 'Loading folder…' forever when getChatFolder fails
trigger: Right-click a folder tab > Edit Folder when no fresh spec is cached; getChatFolder fails (error answer) or the send fails (toast shown, box still opens).
effect: fetch_pending is cleared only by prefill_from_spec; the GetChatFolder error arm (state/domains/chat_list/error.rs) only drops the removal queue. The box stays on 'Loading folder' with no error until it is closed and reopened.
fix: `enum FolderEditorLoad { Create, Fetching(RequestId), Ready, Failed(String) }`, with the GetChatFolder error answer (matched by folder id / request) moving it to Failed and offering Retry.

title: Share Folder busy/error are applied from session one-shots not matched to the folder or request
trigger: Share Folder for folder A > Create link > Save (busy); close the box; open Share Folder for folder B and start editing a link; A's answer lands.
effect: drain_folder_share applies folder_link_saved / folder_share_error to whatever share box is open: B is switched to the List view (losing its form) or shows A's error, and B's busy is cleared while B's own request is still out.
fix: `enum ShareStage { List, Editing{link}, Saving{request, link}, Failed }` in the dialog, and the session answer carries (folder_id, RequestId) compared before applying.

title: Folder invite box keeps seeded and adding bools
trigger: n/a
effect: adding is cleared by an error or a limit hit read elsewhere; seeded marks the first info arrival.
fix: `enum InviteStage { Checking, Ready{selected}, Adding(RequestId), Failed }`.

title: New Contact box stage is sent_name + sent_request + not_joined
trigger: n/a
effect: Three fields kept in step by submit_new_contact, take_new_contact_outcome and the Retry button; answers are matched by request id, so no bug found.
fix: `enum NewContactStage { Editing, Importing{request, name}, NotJoined{name} }`.

title: Network usage is Option<NetworkUsage> + network_loading bool + a shared privacy_data.error
trigger: n/a
effect: Loading, ready and failed are three fields; the error is shared with other privacy-data requests.
fix: `network_usage: Fetch<NetworkUsage>`.

title: Network usage Reset closes its confirm and ignores a send failure
trigger: Settings > Data and Storage > Network usage > Reset statistics > Reset while the TDLib send fails.
effect: `let _ = reset_network_statistics()`: the confirm closes and nothing says the reset did not happen.
fix: Show the send error (set privacy_data.error or a toast) on Err.

title: Per-network auto-download editor closes on send; a TDLib refusal loses the edited draft
trigger: Settings > Data and Storage > Wi-Fi > change caps > Save; setAutoDownloadSettings is refused.
effect: The editor is taken before the answer; only a failed send restores it. On a refusal the page shows the error line but the edits are gone and the overview shows the old values.
fix: `enum StorageEditor { Editing(net, draft), Saving{net, draft, request} }`; close on the matched ok, return to Editing on the matched error.

title: Storage stats and auto-download presets are Option/seeded data beside loading bools
trigger: n/a
effect: storage_stats + storage_stats_loading, and data_storage.seeded + auto_download_presets_loading, are each kept in step by hand (error arms do clear them).
fix: `storage_stats: Fetch<StorageStats>` and `presets: Fetch<Presets>`.

title: StorageScroll holds pending and until_settled bools for one scroll intent
trigger: n/a
effect: Two bools plus the placed offset encode Idle / ScrollNow / ScrollAgainWhenSettled.
fix: `enum StorageScrollIntent { Idle, Now, UntilSettled { placed } }`.

title: Demo setups use assert! in non-test code
trigger: Run --screenshot-demo ready-downloads or ready-voice where playback intent handling differs (e.g. missing demo media file).
effect: The demo process panics during setup (demo-only; no user-facing path).
fix: Replace the asserts (media.rs:205, 208, 331, 336) with a status note or a log line, or move the checks into tests.

title: Collectible gift purchase stage is loading/sending/completed bools (seen via demos/security.rs)
trigger: n/a
effect: Three stage bools plus note on a Stars purchase; any two can be set at once.
fix: `enum GiftPurchaseStage { Quoting, Quoted(GiftQuote), Sending(RequestId), Done, Failed(String) }`.

title: Forum topic first page state is split between threads.topic_load_failed set and TopicHistory.loaded_complete
trigger: n/a
effect: Loading, failed, empty and loaded are inferred from a set membership and fields of a separate map entry, cleared in separate places (session_forum.rs, connect/groups/forum.rs).
fix: One `TopicLoad { Loading(RequestId), Failed, Loaded{complete} }` per (chat, topic) in TopicHistory.

title: Checkout never prefills saved order info or selects the saved card: prefill runs only at open, before the form exists
trigger: Pay once with 'save order info' and a saved card; later press Buy on another invoice. start_invoice_checkout (invoice_checkout.rs:52) sets payments.form = None and opens the dialog right away; open_payment_dialog (payments/mod.rs:33) calls prefill_from_form only if the form is already there, and nothing calls it when the form lands.
effect: Name/phone/email/address fields are empty and the credential choice is 'New card' although TDLib returned saved_order_info and saved_credentials; the user has to retype or reselect everything. The `prefilled` flag is set nowhere else.
fix: Make the checkout a stage value (`Checkout::Loading { dialog } | Ready { dialog, form }`) whose Loading->Ready transition on the form answer runs the prefill; delete the `prefilled` bool.

title: PaymentDialog holds three mutually exclusive sub-screens as separate Option/bool fields
trigger: Open the checkout, open the country box, the New Card form or the 'Turn on Two-Step Verification' prompt.
effect: country_box, card_form and password_prompt can all be set at once; payment_form_body picks one by if-order, and each closer clears only its own field. No bug found today.
fix: One `CheckoutOverlay { None, Country(CountryBox), CardForm(CardForm), AskPassword }` field.

title: A hidden export progress box comes back after switching accounts and back
trigger: Start 'Export chat history' (or 'Export Telegram data'), close its progress box so it runs hidden, switch to another account and back while it runs.
effect: DialogUi is in OnScreen, so chat_export_progress_hidden / account_export_progress_hidden reset to false on the new OnScreen, while the export itself lives on in session.settings.chat_export (per account, survives the switch). The ChatExport/AccountExport box reopens on switch-back; an export that finished while the account was in the background shows the result box instead of the note the user chose. The hidden flag and `*_seen` are also a hand-kept pair beside the session's export.
fix: Keep the shown/hidden choice with the export it is about (a field of the session's `ChatExport` / account export, or an AccountKey-keyed app store), so it moves with the export instead of the screen.

title: create_request is never cleared on success; a refused create is noticed only in the window that may host GroupCallStart
trigger: Start a video chat (or 'Start Streaming') successfully; later the server refuses another create.
effect: group_call_boxes.create_request keeps the last successful RequestId forever; session.calls.failed_creates is drained only by group_call_create_frame_upkeep, gated on dialog_may_show_in(GroupCallStart) (window_upkeep.rs:117), so a failure waits until that window (last press) draws a frame. Works today because ids do not repeat.
fix: A `CreateCall { Sent(RequestId), Joined }` value cleared by the answer and the error, owned by the session request, not a UI Option left behind.

title: The invisible Waiting step drains only in the window that asked; a minimized asking chat window strands it
trigger: In a chat window's header press 'Start video chat' and minimize that window before getVideoChatAvailableParticipants answers.
effect: CreateStep::Waiting is not drawn (is_open false) and its answer is applied only by the asking window's frame upkeep; with that window not drawing, nothing shows and no feedback until the window comes back. Pressing Start again replaces the flow, so it recovers.
fix: Apply the join-as answer in the session-wide poll (matched by the RequestId already in Waiting) and only open the box in the asking window.

title: Schedule box keeps its 'out of range' error after a valid time is picked
trigger: Open 'Schedule video chat', pick a time less than the minimum ahead, press Schedule (error shows), then pick a valid time.
effect: ScheduleStep::error is cleared only by the next Schedule press; the red error stays under a valid pick.
fix: Derive the error from the picked value at render (check_schedule) instead of storing it, or clear it on picker change.

title: The current call is ended before the create request is sent; a local send failure leaves the user out of both
trigger: Be in a video chat, start a video chat or RTMP stream in another chat, confirm 'Leave' while the connection is closing (start_video_chat / start_rtmp_stream returns Err).
effect: send_group_call_create and start_rtmp_stream_now call end_current_call_for_create first; on Err only a server-error toast follows, the old call is already left and nothing is created.
fix: Send the create first and end the current call when the send succeeded (still before the server answers, as tdesktop), or keep the leave in a Leaving stage that is undone on send failure.

title: RTMP start process keeps `failed: bool` beside `info: Option` and a request list
trigger: Open 'Stream with...', let the URL request fail or revoke the key with the request failing.
effect: RtmpStart { info, failed, requests } is a Fetch with a sticky failed flag the UI clears per frame (rtmp_start_frame_upkeep); RtmpStartUi { key_shown, confirm } is reset by hand in four places. No bug found today.
fix: `RtmpStart::state: Fetch<RtmpInfo>` plus a one-shot error event; the box's reveal/confirm as one `RtmpBoxView { Rows { key_shown }, Confirm(RtmpConfirm) }`.

title: Storage clear is a bool plus Option result plus error field
trigger: Settings > Data and Storage > Manage local storage > Clear.
effect: session.settings.storage_clearing, storage_freed and data_storage_error are kept in step by hand in connect/settings/storage.rs, settings/apply.rs and settings/error.rs; all three paths reset the flag today.
fix: `storage_clear: Fetch<i64>` (idle, clearing, freed, failed).

title: 'Clear selected' drops the selection and does nothing, silently, when the clear is refused
trigger: Open Manage local storage, tick types, press Clear selected and confirm while the chat path is not active (connecting/reconnecting).
effect: run_storage_clear clears storage_selected before clear_storage, whose early refusal (`!chats_path_active() || storage_clearing`, storage.rs:153) returns InvalidRequest without setting data_storage_error; the result is ignored (`let _`). The confirm closes, ticks are gone, nothing is cleared and no message shows.
fix: Clear the selection on the clear's answer, and have the refusal set the error (or return it to the caller to show).

title: Each poll option's attach UI is four independent flags; sticker and emoji waits can point at different rows
trigger: In New Poll, press the smiley on option 1, then 'Sticker' on option 2 (or close the panel without picking).
effect: OptionAttach::menu_open, link_input, sticker_wait and emoji_wait are separate; choose_poll_option_sticker clears sticker_wait on all rows but not emoji_wait on others, and a sticker_wait outlives a closed panel and takes the next sticker clicked in it while the poll box is open. No wrong send found.
fix: One `PollAttachMode { None, Menu(row), Link(row, input), WaitSticker(row), WaitEmoji(row) }` on PollDialog/PollAddOption, cleared when the media panel closes.

title: PollDialog's sub-boxes are separate Options/bools
trigger: New Poll: open the deadline box, the country box or the discard confirmation.
effect: deadline_box, country_box and confirming_discard can be set together; focus_question is a one-shot 'mounted' flag. No bug found today.
fix: One `PollOverlay { None, Deadline(DeadlineBox), Countries(CountryBox), ConfirmDiscard }`.

title: Topic editor closes and says 'Topic created/saved' when the request is sent; a server refusal is not shown
trigger: Manage topics > New topic (or edit one), enter a name the server rejects (or lose the right meanwhile), Save.
effect: submit_topic_editor (groups_forum/mod.rs:206-219) sets the success note on Ok(send) and clears `editor`; threads/error.rs has no CreateForumTopic/EditForumTopic arm, so the error is dropped. The user sees success and the typed name is gone.
fix: Keep the editor in a `Saving(RequestId)` stage closed by the answer, and route the topic create/edit error to the dialog.

title: Welcome message edit row closes as saved on send; the edit's server error is not tied back
trigger: Info panel > Welcome message, edit one, Save while the server refuses it.
effect: submit_welcome_edit (groups_welcome.rs:80-124) shows 'updated' on Ok(send) and clears `editing`; no error routing for the edit purpose was found (groups/error.rs handles only LoadChatWelcomeMessages). `editing` + shared `edit_input` is also a hand-kept pair.
fix: `editing: Option<WelcomeEdit { id, input, stage }>` with a Saving(RequestId) stage cleared by the answer or error.

title: RemoveSelectedChats reads the live selection at confirm time instead of what was confirmed
trigger: Select chats, press Delete, and before confirming change folder by a shortcut (set_chat_list_view clears selection) or let a selected chat leave the list.
effect: The confirm deletes selected ∩ listed at submit; what was shown when the box opened can differ (fewer chats, or none with the count text stale). The comment's claim that the dialog blocks selection changes is not enforced by any type.
fix: Carry the chat ids in the action (`RemoveSelectedChats(Vec<ChatId>)`), snapshotted when the box opens.

title: DiskUi keeps the disk stage as DiskState plus five bools
trigger: Fill the disk below the floors, with or without a call, then free space.
effect: confirming, unwritable, screen_refused, held_for_call and start_refused refine DiskState and are reset by hand in apply_disk_reading, enter_disk_state, reconnect_after_disk and close_clients_for_full_disk. No bug found today.
fix: Fold into one `DiskStage { Healthy, Low, Confirming, Full { held_for_call }, ScreenRefused }` plus the reading facts.

title: DraftTimer's `running` bool must stay in step with a detached task
trigger: Type in the composer.
effect: `running` is set by arm and cleared only by step; if the task ever ends without stepping (its update fails), arm returns false forever and debounced drafts stop committing. Today the task holds only a WeakEntity of the app, so this needs the app gone.
fix: Store the task itself (`Option<Task<()>>`) so its presence is the running stage and dropping it resets it.

title: Dropping a folder on 'send the folder's files' walks it on the UI thread
trigger: Drag a folder from a slow or network drive onto the chat and drop it on the folder-files zone.
effect: folder_files_for_sending (drop_modes.rs:253) does read_dir on the folder and every subfolder synchronously in drop_on_zone; the drag probe was moved off the UI thread for exactly this stall (note_file_drag comment), but the drop was not. The window freezes until the listing returns.
fix: Run the folder listing with run_off_ui_scoped_then, matched to the send slot as archive_ready does.

title: The Downloads panel's open flag lives in the core Session
trigger: Open the Downloads panel, switch accounts and back (or open a chat window).
effect: session.media.downloads_panel_open is UI state kept in the per-account Session, written directly from the UI (downloads.rs:233); it follows the account rather than the screen/window that opened it.
fix: Move the open flag to OnScreen (or the window's slot) beside the other panel flags.

title: TON and Stars transaction boxes are two Options closed together
trigger: Monetization page: open a TON row's details or a Stars row's receipt.
effect: earn.ton_tx and earn.star_tx back two dialogs and close_earn_tx clears both; both set would open two boxes. No path sets both today.
fix: One `tx_box: Option<EarnTxBox { Ton(..), Stars(..) }>`.

title: A join box parked for the recipients (EarnState::pending_join) is not dropped by the switch Farewell or by leaving the earn layer, and opens later unasked
trigger: Fresh session: open your own bot's profile, click 'Affiliate Program' (open_bot_affiliate_join, connect/earn.rs:630-652) so the box parks in pending_join while getCreatedPublicChats/getOwnedBots load; before both answer, switch to another account (or close the profile/earn layer and go to another chat). close_earn_boxes only clears pending_join through close_join_box, which runs only when join_box is Some.
effect: When the recipients land (state/domains/payments/earn.rs:407-411) pending_join becomes join_box: the 'Join program' box pops up later on its own, over an unrelated screen, or on switching back to the account.
fix: Make the join box one value, enum JoinBoxStage { Closed, AwaitingRecipients(JoinBox), Open(JoinBox) }, closed whole by close_join_box/Farewell and by leaving the earn surface that asked.

title: Recipient loading is a u8 counter beside Option<Vec> recipients and Option<JoinBox> pending_join kept in step by hand
trigger: Any join from 'View existing programs' or a bot's profile while the recipient list loads.
effect: No bug beyond the parked join box opening unasked (close_earn_boxes entry); three fields encode Unasked/Loading(n)/Ready plus a parked box.
fix: Fetch<Vec<EarnPeer>> for the recipients (with the two-request join inside the loader) and the parked box as a stage of the join box enum.

title: Join Program / Revoke answers are not matched to the box that sent them (JoinBox::joining, RevokeBox::sending are bools, answers carry no request id)
trigger: Click 'Join Program' for bot A, press Esc to close the box, open bot B's join box before A's connectAffiliateProgram answers. A's success (state/domains/payments/earn.rs:178-190) closes B's box and opens A's link box; A's error (:511-515) clears B's joining flag and toasts 'Failed'.
effect: The box the user is looking at closes or changes to another program's link box; a closed box's error toasts over an unrelated one.
fix: Give JoinBox and RevokeBox a stage enum Idle | Sending(RequestId) and apply Connect/Disconnect answers only when the open box waits_for that request, as Withdraw and SetupPage already do.

title: A program row click's resolve answer opens the join or link box even after the list that asked was closed
trigger: Setup page > 'View existing programs', click a program row (open_affiliate_program), then close the programs box or the earn layer before getChatAffiliateProgram answers.
effect: The join box (or the link box) opens over whatever is on screen now, for a list the user already left.
fix: Carry the asking surface in EarnPurpose::ConnectedProgram and drop the answer unless that list (programs box or the Join page for that peer) is still open.

title: LayerFade keeps the earn layer's open/closing stage as a closing bool plus a close_id counter next to the glide
trigger: Close the earn layer and reopen it within the 110 ms fade.
effect: Works today (the timer checks closing && close_id), but the stage is two fields kept in step.
fix: enum LayerFade { Opening(Glide), Closing { glide: Glide, id: u64 } } so the timer matches on Closing { id }.

title: EarnUi::link_shown mirrors the session's link_box by a per-frame diff in the main window's upkeep
trigger: With a referral link box open, a Connect answer for another program replaces link_box (Some -> Some): link_shown stays set.
effect: The link icon's play-once animation does not replay for the new program's box; the mirror also only updates while the main window runs frame upkeep.
fix: Record the open instant with the link box value (keyed by the program url) when it is set, instead of diffing Option presence every frame.

title: Setup sliders are two Options built once from the setup page and never re-keyed to the bot or rebuilt when the page's params are replaced
trigger: Open a bot's affiliate setup, then have earn.setup replaced without open_earn (a reload of the same panel through load_earn_panel after setup was cleared, or the demo path where open_earn keeps the old setup).
effect: The slider knobs keep the old stops/positions while the labels (format_commission of setup.params) show the new values.
fix: One Option<SetupSliders { bot_user_id, commission, duration }> rebuilt when bot_user_id or the program differs from earn.setup.

title: drain_earn shows only the last earn note; earlier ones in the same poll are dropped
trigger: Two earn results land in one poll pass, e.g. 'Failed: ...' from a revoke and the 'Affiliate program updated' note, or the withdrawal 'amount is too small' note with another failure.
effect: Only the last toast shows; the other message is lost.
fix: Queue every note (set_note per item, or a toast queue) instead of notes.into_iter().last().

title: EmojiBarUi::sets_asked is set before the installed emoji set list request is sent and stays set when it is not sent
trigger: Premium user: the ':' suggestion builds while self.live is None or ensure_suggestion_emoji_sets fails to send (send_json error). The flag is set by mem::replace before the send; later queries pass list=false.
effect: The installed emoji sets are never listed for this composer, so custom emoji never appear in the suggestion bar until the composer UI is rebuilt (account switch / new window).
fix: Drop the UI flag and let the driver key the ask on its own request state (has_purpose / installed_loaded), or set it only on a successful send.

title: Edit Image's decode continuation opens the photo editor for whatever edit is pending when it lands; EditorPurpose::MessageEdit carries no message key
trigger: Edit own photo message A, choose Edit media > Edit Image (a large original takes a moment to decode); before it lands press Esc and start editing photo message B (same or another chat in that window). Then press Done and save the edit.
effect: The editor shows A's photo; Done stages it as B's replacement (save_photo_editor compares edited_message() at Done time, which is B), so B is edited to A's picture.
fix: EditorPurpose::MessageEdit(ChatMessage) captured in begin_edit_image; the decode continuation and finish_edit_image apply only when the pending edit is still that message.

title: The Edit Cover file picker's answer is staged on whatever edit is pending when it returns, not the edit that asked
trigger: Edit own video message A, choose Edit media > Edit Cover; while the (non-modal) file chooser is open, cancel the edit and start editing message B in the same chat, then pick an image.
effect: The cover is staged on B's edit ('Cover will be saved with ...') and sent with B's editMessageMedia; for a photo B the cover goes with a media that has no cover tool.
fix: Capture the edited ChatMessage when the picker opens and have set_edit_cover apply only when pending_edit is still that message.

title: The 'watching' action sends the emoji of the first active effect in the chat, not of the effect that just started
trigger: In a 1:1 chat with two different lone emoji messages, the partner taps one, then the other; the second effect starts while the first is still in ACTIVE.
effect: send_watching_animations reports the first effect's emoji for the second start, so the partner's client shows the wrong 'watching' emoji.
fix: Push the started effect itself (chat, message) into `watched` and compute message_emoji from it.

title: Emoji effect ANCHORS and ACTIVE are process-wide thread-locals keyed by (chat id, message id) without the account
trigger: Tap an emoji in a 1:1 chat with user X on account A, switch at once to account B and open its chat with the same user X (same chat id).
effect: A's queued/playing effect survives the switch and can start or draw over B's message with the same id if one is painted; otherwise it lingers until its wait ends.
fix: Key effects and anchors by owner (OfAccount<ChatMessage> plus window) or clear ACTIVE in the screen's Farewell.

title: A pending emoji effect gets its START_WAIT clock when a window takes it, not when it arrived, so taps queued while locked play late
trigger: Open a 1:1 chat, lock Quill; the partner taps the big emoji several times; unlock. The locked window never runs emoji_effect_overlay, so the session's pending queue (up to MAX_PENDING) waits.
effect: At the unlock the old effects start (queued = now) if the emoji's anchor is still noted, and 'watching' is sent for taps long past (tdesktop drops after kMaxDelay).
fix: Stamp EmojiEffect with its arrival time in the session and drop it in take_pending/advance_effects when older than START_WAIT.

title: Emoji packs box: closing does not cancel the debounced search or clear the search field
trigger: Open Settings > Emoji sets, type 'cat', close the box within 300 ms (search goes out with the box closed and switches emoji.tab to Search); or type 'cat', wait, close and reopen.
effect: A search request runs for a closed box; on reopen the field still reads 'cat' while the list and tab show Installed until the field is edited.
fix: Hold the box as one value (open, tab, query, keystroke token) that close_emoji_sets drops; bump the token and clear the field on close/open.

title: EmojiPanel::failed and mutation_failed are flags shared by the emoji sets box, the emoji status picker and the group edit box, beside a loading state derived from requests
trigger: An emoji status picker lookup fails to send (connect/emoji_sets.rs:196) or a group emoji-pack request fails, then the emoji packs box is opened with its request already in flight (emoji_set_request returns early without clearing failed).
effect: The packs box can show 'Could not update emoji packs' for another surface's failure.
fix: Fetch<_> per list (installed, trending, search) and a per-mutation result, each read only by its own surface.

title: WithdrawStep::Password carries a `sending` bool and an error Option inside the variant
trigger: Submit the withdrawal password.
effect: Works today (the request id on Withdraw matches answers), but Sending is a flag inside a stage.
fix: Split into WithdrawStep::Password { error } and WithdrawStep::SendingPassword, so sending and an error cannot coexist.

title: Each revenue box is a field (learn bool, ton_tx, star_tx, ask_boost) set by hand next to a separate open_box(DialogKind) call
trigger: Open the Learn more box (revenue.rs:104-113); the demo sets earn.learn without open_box (demo.rs:96).
effect: No user bug found; the box flag and its window record are two writes kept in step at every opener.
fix: One Option<EarnBox> enum (Learn { diamonds }, TonTx, StarTx, AskBoost) opened by one helper that also records the asking window.

title: A bot photo asked for by a program list is never asked again when its download fails
trigger: Open an affiliate programs page while the photo download of a listed bot fails (network drop).
effect: photos_asked keeps the bot, so its row shows initials until the account switches (OnScreen is rebuilt).
fix: Leave the retry to the file layer (ask while user_photo_path is None and no download is active) instead of an asked-once set.

title: A finished emoji set download switches to its set even after the user chose another set
trigger: Settings > Chat > Choose emoji set: click Twemoji (not downloaded, download starts), then click an already downloaded set or the system font while the download runs; wait for the download to finish.
effect: The set the user picked last is replaced by the downloaded one when it lands (also the startup fallback download overrides a choice made meanwhile). choose_emoji_set -> switch_emoji_set never cancels state.download, and the download task calls switch_emoji_set(id) unconditionally on Ok.
fix: One EmojiSetStage enum {Idle, Switching{id,task}, Downloading{id,progress,task}, Failed{id,why}}: any new choice replaces the stage, which cancels the download, and the download continuation switches only while its stage is still current.

title: EmojiStyleUi keeps the set choice's stages in started, download, download_task, switch_task, failed, file_task and file_error
trigger: n/a
effect: Downloading, switching, failed and file-install stages are separate Options kept in step by hand (download_emoji_set clears failed and file_error; install_emoji_set_file cancels download but leaves download_task running). started is a one-shot bool.
fix: An enum for the choice in flight (Idle/Switching/Downloading/InstallingFile/Failed) carrying its task and error; startup as Unloaded/Loading/Loaded.

title: Emoji set download notifies the whole app every 120 ms even while its box is closed
trigger: Start an emoji set download, close the Choose emoji set box (the download keeps going by design).
effect: Wasted work: QuillApp is notified and redrawn about 8 times a second for the whole download, with no progress drawn anywhere.
fix: Notify only while the box is open (or give the progress its own entity that the box observes).

title: "Suggest Emoji" silently does nothing when its keyword lookup is not sent or has failed out
trigger: Right-click a word in the composer and choose Suggest Emoji while the keyword lookup for it has failed ATTEMPTS times (or is refused: in-flight cap full, chats path inactive).
effect: emoji_words.asked waits for keyword_lookups.answer(word), which never comes (wants() is false after the failures, and sync_emoji_words only re-asks the highlighted candidates); no bar and no 'no emoji' note appear. asked stays until the text changes.
fix: Make asked an enum Asked{range, word} | Gave{..} resolved by a lookup outcome (Answered/GaveUp) from KeywordLookups, so a failed or unsent lookup shows the Q_CHAT_EMOJI_WORD_NONE note.

title: The word bar's stages are hovered + pinned + pending + asked kept in step by hand
trigger: n/a
effect: pinned only means something while hovered is Some (unhover clears both); pending is a separate timer stage; asked is a fourth independent Option for the same bar.
fix: enum WordBar { Closed, Asked{range,word}, Shown{word, items, pinned: Origin, aim: Option<(BarAim, Task)>} }.

title: A link tooltip stays on screen after the chat changes under the pointer
trigger: Rest the pointer on a text link until its tooltip shows, then switch chat with the keyboard (e.g. Ctrl+Tab / Alt+Down) without moving the mouse.
effect: The old link's address tooltip stays over the new chat until the pointer moves onto and off another link; nothing on the chat change clears message_ui.link_tooltip (only queue_link, note_right_clicked_link and the message menu do). Also LinkTooltip.shown is a Waiting/Shown stage as a bool.
fix: Keep the tooltip in ChatUi (replaced on chat change) with an enum TooltipStage { Waiting{token}, Shown }.

title: Instant View is session-wide state drawn in every window
trigger: Open a chat in its own window, click an Instant View link there.
effect: session.messages.instant_view is drawn by both app_render/mod.rs:580 and chat_window/body.rs:149, so the page covers the main window and every chat window; Escape in any window (it is in WINDOW_LAYERS) closes it in all; instant_view_fallback_url is taken and opened by whichever window renders first.
fix: Record the asking window with the page (InstantViewOpen{window, page}) or move the open page into the WindowSlot, and draw/close it only there.

title: LayerFocus tracks open/closed with was_open beside two Options
trigger: n/a
effect: base, open_focus and was_open together encode NoLayer{base} / LayerOpen{base, open_focus}; each frame keeps them in step by hand.
fix: enum LayerFocus { Idle{base}, Open{base, open_focus} }.

title: Recent actions auto-load of a short list is keyed by length only and never reset
trigger: Open Recent actions of group A whose (filtered or searched) first page is short and has_more; it auto-loads once. Then open group B (or change the filter/search on A) where the short first page has the same number of events.
effect: event_log_autoload already equals page.events.len(), so the next page is never asked for; the list cannot scroll, so the scroll handler never fires and the 'Loading older' spinner stays. The Cell lives in AdminUi and nothing resets it (only an account switch).
fix: Key the auto-load by (chat_id, filter/query generation, length), or hold the older-page load as a Fetch-like stage per chat in the session.

title: Recent actions page keeps event_log_hooked, event_log_poll and event_log_keystroke as separate stage fields
trigger: n/a
effect: event_log_poll: Option<ChatId> is a 'poll running' flag cleared by the loop's tail through the main window; event_log_hooked is a one-shot bool; the search debounce token is a counter. They are correct today but kept in step by hand.
fix: An EventLogPage { chat_id, poll: Task, search_debounce: Option<Task> } value owned by the RecentActions view, dropped when the view changes.

title: A hidden chat-export progress box comes back after switching accounts and back
trigger: Start a chat export on account A, press Hide, switch to account B, switch back to A while the export still runs.
effect: chat_export_progress_hidden lives in DialogUi (OnScreen, rebuilt false on the switch) while the export lives in A's Session, so the ChatExport dialog predicate is true again and the progress box pops open.
fix: Keep whether the progress is shown with the export (ChatExport carries shown/hidden) or default the rebuilt screen to hidden for a running export.

title: Export box mode is chat_export_dialog + chat_export_progress_hidden + chat_export_seen + the session's export
trigger: n/a
effect: Options / Calendar / Progress / Hidden / Closed are derived from an Option draft (with picking: Option<DateField>), a bool and the session's export; on_close, Cancel, Done and Hide each set a different subset.
fix: enum ChatExportBox { Closed, Options(ChatExportDraft), Progress, Hidden } with picking inside Options.

title: FirstRun::Welcome holds the clip stage as intro: Option plus writing: bool
trigger: n/a
effect: Writing / Playing(player) / NoClip are an Option and a bool; after a skip during the write, intro_written ignores the answer and writing stays true forever (harmless today because outro drives the look).
fix: enum Clip { Writing, Playing(VideoPlayer), None } inside Welcome.

title: A replayed intro clip keeps playing with sound under the passcode lock
trigger: Settings > Advanced > replay onboarding, then lock Quill (passcode hotkey) while the clip plays.
effect: The lock draws only the lock screen, so first_run_view/first_run_curtain (which run settle, the volume fade and the pause) stop running, and close_for_lock does not touch app.first_run: the clip's audio plays on to its end behind the lock.
fix: close_for_lock pauses or finishes FirstRun (skip_intro + pause the player), or the player is paused by the lock gate.

title: The fact-check box closes as saved before TDLib answers; a rejected save loses the text
trigger: In a channel, message menu > Add Fact Check, type a note, Save while the server rejects it (no right to add fact checks, text refused).
effect: submit_fact_check takes fact_check_dialog and the box closes on send with 'Saving the fact check'; nothing handles a SetMessageFactCheck error (no grep hit outside purpose.rs/message_menu.rs), so the user sees the box gone with no specific error and the typed text is lost.
fix: Keep the box in a Saving{request} stage until the ok/error for that RequestId arrives; on error return to Editing with the text and an error line.

title: Folder editor stays on 'Loading folder...' forever when getChatFolder fails or cannot be sent
trigger: Open Settings > Folders, click a folder whose spec is not cached (or stale) while the connection drops or TDLib answers getChatFolder with an error (e.g. folder deleted on another device meanwhile).
effect: The editor shows only the name field and 'Loading folder...' with no error; only Cancel gets out, and reopening is the only retry. fetch_pending is cleared only by maybe_prefill_folder_editor on success; the GetChatFolder error arm (state/domains/chat_list/error.rs:87) only prunes folder_remove_queue, and open_folder_edit's send Err only sets a toast.
fix: Make the editor's content a Fetch<FolderEditor> (Loading{request}/Ready/Failed) keyed by the getChatFolder request id, with the error arm moving it to Failed and showing a Retry.

title: Save is live while the editor is still loading, and sends a blank spec for an existing folder
trigger: Open Edit for a folder whose spec must be fetched; before it arrives type a name into the visible name field and click Save.
effect: save_folder_editor ignores fetch_pending and sends editChatFolder with FolderEditor::new() (no chats, no types, default icon) under the typed name; the box closes with 'Folder updated'. TDLib most likely refuses an empty folder, so the user sees success while nothing (or a wiped folder) was saved.
fix: With the editor content as Fetch<FolderEditor>, Save exists only in the Ready variant (disabled otherwise).

title: Folder editor closes as saved on send, before TDLib answers create/editChatFolder
trigger: Create or edit a folder so that TDLib rejects it with a non-limit error (e.g. FILTER_INCLUDE_EMPTY for a folder with no chats/types, or a flood error).
effect: The box closes at once with 'Folder created/updated'; a non-limit error has no handler in apply_chat_list_error for CreateChatFolder/EditChatFolder, so the user's edits are lost with a success toast. Only a limit error comes back (drain_folder_limit), and then the editor is already gone.
fix: Keep the editor open in a Saving{request} stage and close it on the matching answer; an error moves it back to Editing with the error.

title: Share Folder save answer (folder_link_saved bool) is not matched to the form or folder that asked
trigger: In Share Folder, edit a link and click Save (busy); click Cancel before the answer (busy=false, back to List), then click Create link to open a new form. Or: Save in folder A's Share box, Done, open Share for folder B and start a new link.
effect: The first save's answer flips the session-wide folder_link_saved, and drain_folder_share sets view=List on whatever share box is open, throwing away the new form the user is filling (possibly another folder's). Cancel also clears busy while the request is still in flight, so Save can be pressed again for a duplicate create; a delete/getLinks error landing in folder_share_error likewise clears busy on a pending save.
fix: Make the form stage an enum Edit{link, saving: Option<RequestId>} and store the save answer keyed by request id (or folder_id + link), applied only when it matches the open form.

title: Share Folder stays on 'Loading folder...' / 'Loading links...' when the fetch fails
trigger: Open Share Folder for a folder without a fresh cached spec while getChatFolder fails (connection drop, folder removed on another device) or the send itself errors.
effect: folder_link_list shows 'Loading folder...' forever: the GetChatFolder error arm stores nothing and the send error only toasts. Only Done gets out.
fix: Track the share box's spec and links as Fetch<T> per folder (Loading/Ready/Failed) so the error arm leaves Loading and the box can show the error and retry.

title: Add-folder-by-link box shows 'Checking link...' forever when checkChatFolderInviteLink cannot be sent
trigger: Click a t.me/addlist link while the chats path is not active yet (just after connect) or while sending fails.
effect: open_folder_invite only toasts the send error; folder_invite_info and folder_invite_error stay None so the box spins 'Checking link...' with only Close. When chats_path_active() is false the driver returns before resetting folder_invite_info, so info left from an earlier link (e.g. a box dropped by an account switch, which has no Farewell clearing the session fields) can be shown under the new link.
fix: Keep the check as one enum on the dialog (Checking{request}/Checked(info)/Failed(err)/Adding{request}/Done) set from the send result too; the session answers keyed by request id.

title: Add-folder box: seeded + adding bools plus session info/error/done one-shots kept in step by hand
trigger: Click Add in the add-folder box; the add's answer is lost (request dropped on a reconnect) or an error lands and the user retries.
effect: adding is cleared only when folder_invite_error is Some (or a limit hit); a dropped answer leaves the button spinning and disabled until the box is closed. Stages live across FolderInviteDialog::{seeded,adding} and ChatListState::{folder_invite_info,folder_invite_error,folder_invite_done}.
fix: One FolderInviteStage enum on the dialog (see the checking finding); every stage, Adding included, is left by the matching answer, error or close.

title: Add-folder box re-sends getChat for unknown chats on every poll pass after a failure
trigger: Open an addlist link whose info lists a chat TDLib cannot return (getChat error, e.g. chat inaccessible) and leave the box open.
effect: drive_folder_invite calls fetch_chats_for_folder_invite every poll pass; the driver dedups only against an in-flight request and GetFolderInviteChat has no error handling, so each error answer wakes the poll and a new getChat goes out: a request loop at round-trip speed while the box is open.
fix: Remember the asked chat ids per invite (a HashSet in the invite stage, or a Fetch per chat) and ask each once.

title: A folder limit hit is not matched to the request that hit it: it clears busy/adding on whichever box is open and guesses the window
trigger: With a Share Folder link save in flight, create a folder from Settings that hits the folder limit (or vice versa).
effect: drain_folder_limit takes the session-wide folder_limit_hit and clears FolderShareDialog::busy and FolderInviteDialog::adding unconditionally, re-enabling Save/Add while their own requests are still in flight; the limit box goes to the window of whichever of invite/share/editor is open, not the one whose request failed.
fix: Carry the asking request id (or FolderOp + dialog) in folder_limit_hit and leave only that dialog's in-flight stage.

title: Add to folder box spins 'Loading folder options...' forever when getChatListsToAddChat fails
trigger: Open a chat's Add to folder box while the request fails (offline, error answer).
effect: folder_menu_panel shows the loading line until chat_lists_for_add has the chat; no error arm handles GetChatListsToAddChat, and the send error only toasts. Only closing the box gets out.
fix: Hold the box's destinations as Fetch<Vec<ChatList>> keyed by chat, with the error arm moving it to Failed.

title: Delete-folder box has no loading stage for the chats-to-leave list
trigger: Delete a shared folder and click Delete before getChatFolderChatsToLeave answers.
effect: The box shows the plain 'Delete' text as if there were nothing to leave; confirm_folder_delete reads whatever is in the session at click time, so an early click deletes the folder without offering to leave its chats.
fix: Give FolderDeleteConfirm a Fetch<Vec<i64>> for the suggestions (shared folders only) and disable the confirm while Loading.

title: Join box for a shared folder's new chats keeps ticks for chats no longer offered
trigger: Open the 'N new chats' join box; while it is open the poll refreshes folder_new_chats and the owner removed a chat; click Join.
effect: selected was seeded at open and is never pruned against the current list; confirm sends ids that are no longer offered, so the request can fail with an error toast after the box closed.
fix: Send selected ∩ the current folder_new_chats list (or rebuild the selection when the list changes).

title: Force-reply arming is main-window-only: a bot's forced reply in a chat shown in a chat window is dropped
trigger: Open a bot chat in its own chat window (not the main window), trigger a bot message with replyMarkupForceReply.
effect: The poll takes pending_force_reply and drain_force_reply arms only when session.open_chat (the main view) is that chat; otherwise the target is consumed and lost, so the chat window's composer never gets the reply-to or the bar (comment at notifications/mod.rs:602 admits it).
fix: Route the target to the window whose slot shows target.chat_id (in_window_scope), or keep it per chat until a window showing the chat drains it.

title: A forward's answer clears a newer selection made in the same conversation
trigger: Select messages in chat A and forward them to B (Send); before TDLib answers, start selecting other messages in A.
effect: present_forward_result clears share.forward whenever the stored draft is from the same chat and topic as the answer (submit_share already set it to None), so the new selection disappears when the old forward's answer lands. With several destinations each answer does it again.
fix: After Send, keep the sent forward's request ids (or a send token) and clear the stage only when the current draft is the one that was sent; a draft started later carries a new token.

title: ForwardLift global bool marks a lifted message drag
trigger: Lift a message drag and release outside any window, or the drag is cancelled without a mouse-up reaching end_forward_lift.
effect: The bool can stay true; forward_lift_live also checks has_active_drag so nothing wrong shows today.
fix: Store Option<ForwardDrag> (the drag in flight) as the global, or derive it from cx.active_drag's type instead of a separate flag.

title: Password field focus is tracked by a separate *_password_focused bool beside the box stage
trigger: Open the gift export or Grams withdrawal password box.
effect: keep_password_field keeps PaymentsUi::{gift_export_password_focused, grams_withdraw_password_focused} in step with the stage by hand each frame; no bug found today.
fix: Put the focused-once marker inside the Password stage variant (TransferStage::Password / GramWithdraw::Password) so it resets with the stage.

title: Raise Bid on an auction whose bid is for a channel re-places it for the user, moving the gift's recipient
trigger: In another client, bid in a gift auction with a channel as recipient. In Quill, click the chat-list auction bar (or Active Auctions > Raise Bid), move the slider up, press the bid button.
effect: raise_active_bid maps a MessageSender::Chat owner to recipient None, auction_recipient falls back to the user, and bid_gift_auction sees a different owner so it sends placeGiftAuctionBid for the user instead of increaseGiftAuctionBid: Stars are spent and the gift goes to the user, not the channel, with no ChangeRecipient box shown.
fix: Carry the bid's owner as the recipient in a `BidTarget { gift_id, owner: MessageSender }` value the bid box sends, or refuse/route to ChangeRecipient when the owner is a chat; never fall back to the user for a raise.

title: Auction info box re-sends getGiftUpgradePreview on every render after it fails
trigger: Open a gift auction's info box (link or tile) for a gift whose upgrade preview request fails (error from TDLib, or offline).
effect: auction_info_box calls fetch_gift_upgrade_preview each render; the error arm for UpgradePreview stores nothing (gift_market.rs apply error is a no-op), so `previews` never gets the key and the request goes out again every redraw, at least once a second from the box's 1 fps tick, for as long as the box is open.
fix: Keep the preview as `Fetch<GiftPreview>` per gift id (failed is a stage), ask from an open action not from render, and do not retry a failed fetch until the box reopens.

title: 'Items bought' box says Loading forever when getGiftAuctionAcquiredGifts fails
trigger: Open an auction where you won gifts, click 'N items bought' while the request fails (offline, server error).
effect: The error arm for AcquiredGifts does nothing, `acquired` never gets the gift id, and the box shows 'Loading...' until closed; no error toast.
fix: Store `acquired` as `HashMap<i64, Fetch<Vec<AcquiredGift>>>` so the error lands in a Failed stage the box shows.

title: Closing the gift box during the forge drops the craft's answer: gifts are used up with no result or error shown
trigger: Craft Gift > Craft. While the forge animation runs (craftGift in flight), press Escape or click outside the box.
effect: The dialog's on_close runs market_back, after_craft_pop sets market.craft = None and forge_started = None; the craft answer (success, fail or error) is matched by craft_request against a craft that is gone and dropped. The gifts are spent, but the user never sees the new gift, the failure, or an error note.
fix: Model the craft as `CraftStage { Editing, Forging { request, started }, Done(CraftResult) }`; while Forging the box refuses to close (as tdesktop), or the in-flight craft is kept past the box like `buy` and its answer toasts.

title: Craft progress split across UI forge_started, session crafting/craft_request and result
trigger: n/a
effect: Four values (GiftMarketUi::forge_started, CraftSession::crafting, craft_request, result) must agree by hand; craft_frame_upkeep infers the stage from their combination, and market_replace(CraftResult) replaces whatever box is on top at the time.
fix: One `CraftStage` enum on CraftSession (Editing, Forging{request, started}, Done(result)); the forge's minimum time is data of Forging.

title: Craft 'Select Gifts' shows 'none on sale' when the listings search failed
trigger: Craft Gift > + (Select Gifts) while searchGiftsForResale fails (offline, server error).
effect: The SearchResale error arm sets search.loading=false, loaded=true, error=Some(..) and pushes no note; craft_select_box never reads `market.error`, so the user is told there are no suitable gifts on sale instead of an error with retry.
fix: Make ResaleSearch's page state `Fetch<..>` and render the Failed stage (message and retry) in the select box.

title: CraftSession candidates kept as candidates_loading + candidates_loaded + candidates_request
trigger: n/a
effect: Two bools and a request id describe one fetch; the error arm sets loaded=true so a failed load reads as 'no gifts of yours' in the select box (the toast is the only error signal).
fix: `candidates: Fetch<Page<CraftGift>>` carrying its request id.

title: Bid button re-enables while a bid is still in flight once another auction's bid answers
trigger: Place a bid on auction A; before it answers, open auction B's bid box from the bar/Active Auctions and bid there (bidding becomes Some(B) only if A's had cleared). Or: A's answer clears `bidding` unconditionally while B's request is pending.
effect: apply_gift_market_ok/error set `market.bidding = None` without checking the gift id or request, so the button of the box whose bid is still in flight stops spinning and accepts a second press (a second Stars bid).
fix: `bidding: Option<(gift_id, RequestId)>`, cleared only by the answer whose request id matches.

title: Session GIF list stage held as loading/loaded/failed + search_mode/search_loading/search_failed bools
trigger: n/a
effect: gifs_on_their_way and gif_panel_status combine six bools (two fetches plus a mode) to decide spinner, error text and empty text; show_saved_gifs/search_gifs reset them field by field.
fix: `GifPanel { saved: Fetch<Vec<AnimationItem>>, list: GifList::Saved | GifList::Search { query, page: Fetch<..> } }`.

title: window_state_save_pending sticks true if the main window is replaced while the debounced save waits
trigger: Move or resize the main window, and within 600 ms the GPU is lost and the main window is rebuilt (attach_main_window).
effect: schedule_window_state_save spawns in the old window; update_in fails once it is gone, so the flag is never cleared and later moves only stage the geometry: window_state.json is written only at quit, so a crash loses the window's place.
fix: Hold the debounce as `Option<Task<()>>` (replaced on each schedule, cleared by the task or dropped), spawned app-wide rather than in the window, so no flag can outlive it.

title: Frame clock run kept as a frame_clock_running bool beside a detached task
trigger: n/a
effect: FrameUi::frame_clock_running says a detached loop exists; the loop clears it on exit. Works today (every exit path ends with the clear, a dropped app ends via Ticked(0)), but the run and its flag are kept in step by hand and the task cannot be cancelled.
fix: `clock: Option<Task<()>>` (or a `ClockState::Idle | Running(Task)` enum) owned by FrameUi.
